trials.claimQuote: Once you create a proxy-email address, it is reserved for you indefinitely.
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly states a created proxy-email is reserved for you forever and can be re-created with the same address. The vague one-star mention of retention issues does not specifically contradict that reservation promise.

exhibits.quote: I need to update it to 0 tacos: “Nothing working – email retention issues.”
exhibits.argument: Report of email retention failure undermines promise that addresses are reserved indefinitely.

exhibits.quote: Yes, you can just re-create it with the same address. Once you created any proxy-email address it's reserved for you forever.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states a created proxy-email is reserved forever and can be re-created.

trials.claim: Can create unlimited proxy-emails with custom domain
trials.claimQuote: Yes, you can attach your own domain to ProxiedMail, allowing you to create unlimited proxy-emails with your custom domain.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states attaching your domain gives unlimited emails at that domain, and a buyer confirms adding own domains works. The complaint about forwarding to the same domain does not contradict creating unlimited custom-domain addresses.

exhibits.quote: Doesn’t let you forward emails to the same domain aswell.
exhibits.argument: Blocking forwarding to the same domain undermines unlimited custom-domain use.

exhibits.quote: Attach your domain to ProxiedMail to get unlimited emails at your custom domain.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states attaching a domain gives unlimited emails at that custom domain.

exhibits.quote: since you can add your own domains, it can easily replace an expensive M365 or Google Workspace subscription.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms adding own domains works for sending and receiving email.

trials.claim: Service generates unlimited unique proxy-email addresses that forward to real inbox
trials.claimQuote: ProxiedMail is a service that allows users to generate unlimited unique email addresses (proxy-emails) that forward incoming messages to their real email inboxes.
trials.reasoning: A reviewer reports sometimes not receiving forwarded emails at all, and another reports replies eventually expose the real email address. These directly limit the claim that unlimited proxy-emails reliably forward to and protect the real inbox.

exhibits.quote: once your proxied email thread hits the 3-5th reply then it will start to use/show your actual email address
exhibits.argument: Revealing the real inbox address after replies undermines forwarding privacy claim.

exhibits.quote: when testing it sometimes I don’t even receive forwarded emails or I get it 5-10 minutes.
exhibits.argument: Failure to receive forwarded emails undermines claim that proxy-emails forward to real inbox.

exhibits.quote: You can generate unlimited amount of emails at @proxiedmail.com (like helloworld@proxiedmail.com) and all sent emails to the proxy address will be forwarded to your real email like a john@gmai.com.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users can generate unlimited emails that forward to their real email.

exhibits.quote: All incoming emails are seamlessly forwarded to your primary inbox, whether it's on Gmail, ProtonMail, or any other platform of your choice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms incoming emails are forwarded to the user's primary inbox.

trials.claim: Up to 50 real emails, could be increased by request

trials.reasoning: The pricing page directly lists up to 50 real emails that could be increased by request. The review about being unable to change account settings does not address that limit or increase request.

exhibits.quote: It was working fine a few months ago, but now the settings do not allow me to change my account.
exhibits.argument: Inability to change account undermines claim that real-email limit could be increased by request.

exhibits.quote: Up to 50 real emails (could be increased by request)
